dhpak2.3:3.1: Rājagahe kira dhanaseṭṭhikulassa dhītā vayappattakāle mātāpitūhi
dhpak2.3:3.2: sattabhūmikassa pāsādassa uparimatale ativiya rakkhiyamānā yobbanamadamattatāya purisalolā
dhpak2.3:3.3: hutvā attano dāseneva saddhiṃ santhavaṃ katvā, “aññepi me idaṃ kammaṃ jāneyyu”nti
dhpak2.3:3.4: bhītā evamāha – “amhehi imasmiṃ ṭhāne na sakkā vasituṃ. Sace me mātāpitaro
dhpak2.3:3.5: imaṃ dosaṃ jānissanti, khaṇḍākhaṇḍikaṃ maṃ karissanti. Videsaṃ gantvā vasissāmā”ti.
dhpak2.3:4.1: Te hatthasāraṃ gahetvā aggadvārena nikkhamitvā, “yattha vā tattha vā
dhpak2.3:4.2: aññehi ajānanaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā vasissāmā”ti ubhopi agamaṃsu. Tesaṃ ekasmiṃ
dhpak2.3:4.3: ṭhāne vasantānaṃ saṃvāsamanvāya tassā kucchismiṃ gabbho patiṭṭhāsi. Sā
dhpak2.3:4.4: gabbhaparipākaṃ āgamma tena saddhiṃ mantesi, “gabbho me paripākaṃ gato,
dhpak2.3:4.5: ñātibandhuvirahite ṭhāne gabbhavuṭṭhānaṃ nāma ubhinnampi amhākaṃ
dhpak2.3:4.6: dukkhāvahaṃ, kulagehameva gacchāmā”ti. So “sacāhaṃ tattha gamissāmi, jīvitaṃ
dhpak2.3:4.7: me natthī”ti bhayena “ajja gacchāma, sve gacchāmā”ti divase atikkāmesi.
dhpak2.3:5.1: Sā cintesi – “ayaṃ bālo attano dosamahantatāya gantuṃ na ussahati, mātāpitaro
dhpak2.3:5.2: nāma ekantahitāva, ayaṃ gacchatu vā, mā vā, ahaṃ gamissāmī”ti. Sā tasmiṃ gehā
dhpak2.3:5.3: nikkhante gehaparikkhāraṃ paṭisāmetvā attano kulagharaṃ gatabhāvaṃ anantaragehavāsīnaṃ
dhpak2.3:5.4: ārocetvā maggaṃ paṭipajji. Sopi gharaṃ āgantvā taṃ adisvā paṭivissake pucchitvā,
dhpak2.3:5.5: “sā kulagharaṃ gatā”ti sutvā vegena anubandhitvā antarāmagge sampāpuṇi. Tassāpi
dhpak2.3:5.6: tattheva gabbhavuṭṭhānaṃ ahosi. So “kiṃ idaṃ, bhadde”ti pucchi. “Sāmi, me eko
dhpak2.3:5.7: putto jāto”ti. “Idāni kiṃ karissāmā”ti? “Yassatthāya mayaṃ kulagharaṃ gaccheyyāma,
dhpak2.3:5.8: taṃ kammaṃ antarāmaggeva nipphannaṃ, tattha gantvā kiṃ karissāma, nivattissāmā”ti
dhpak2.3:6.1: dvepi ekacittā hutvā nivattiṃsu. Tassa ca dārakassa panthe jātattā panthakoti nāmaṃ
dhpak2.3:6.2: kariṃsu. Tassā nacirasseva aparopi gabbho patiṭṭhahi. Sabbaṃ purimanayeneva
dhpak2.3:6.3: vitthāretabbaṃ. Tassapi dārakassa panthe jātattā paṭhamajātassa mahāpanthakoti nāmaṃ katvā
dhpak2.3:6.4: itarassa cūḷapanthakoti nāmaṃ kariṃsu. Te dvepi dārake gahetvā attano vasanaṭṭhānameva gatā.
dhpak2.3:7.1: Tesaṃ tattha vasantānaṃ mahāpanthakadārako aññe dārake “cūḷapitā mahāpitāti, ayyako
dhpak2.3:7.2: ayyikā”ti ca vadante sutvā mātaraṃ pucchi – “amma, aññe dārakā ‘ayyako ayyikā’tipi, ‘mahāpitā
dhpak2.3:7.3: cūḷapitā’tipi vadanti, kacci amhākaññeva ñātakā natthī”ti? “Āma, tāta, amhākaṃ ettha ñātakā
dhpak2.3:7.4: natthi. Rājagahanagare pana vo dhanaseṭṭhi nāma ayyako, tattha amhākaṃ bahū ñātakā”ti. “Kasmā
dhpak2.3:7.5: tattha na gacchatha, ammā”ti? Sā attano agamanakāraṇaṃ puttassa akathetvā puttesu punappunaṃ
dhpak2.3:7.6: kathentesu sāmikaṃ āha – “ime dārakā maṃ ativiya kilamenti, kiṃ no mātāpitaro disvā maṃsaṃ
dhpak2.3:7.7: khādissanti, ehi, dārakānaṃ ayyakakulaṃ dassessāmā”ti? “Ahaṃ sammukhā bhavituṃ na sakkhissāmi,
dhpak2.3:7.8: te pana nayissāmī”ti. “Sādhu yena kenaci upāyena dārakānaṃ ayyakakulameva daṭṭhuṃ vaṭṭatī”ti.
dhpak2.3:8.1: Dvepi janā dārake ādāya anupubbena rājagahaṃ patvā nagaradvāre
dhpak2.3:8.2: ekissā sālāya pavisitvā dārakamātā dve dārake gahetvā attano āgatabhāvaṃ
dhpak2.3:8.3: mātāpitūnaṃ ārocāpesi. Te taṃ sāsanaṃ sutvā, “saṃsāre vicarantānaṃ
dhpak2.3:8.4: na putto na dhītā bhūtapubbā nāma natthi, te amhākaṃ mahāparādhikā,
dhpak2.3:8.5: na sakkā tehi amhākaṃ cakkhupathe ṭhātuṃ, ettakaṃ nāma dhanaṃ
dhpak2.3:8.6: gahetvā dvepi janā phāsukaṭṭhānaṃ gantvā jīvantu, dārake pana idha
dhpak2.3:8.7: pesentū”ti dhanaṃ datvā dūtaṃ pāhesuṃ. Tehi pesitaṃ dhanaṃ gahetvā dārake
dhpak2.3:8.8: āgatadūtānaññeva hatthe datvā pahiṇiṃsu. Dārakā ayyakakule vaḍḍhanti.
dhpak2.3:9.1: Tesu cūḷapanthako atidaharo, mahāpanthako pana ayyakena saddhiṃ
dhpak2.3:9.2: dasabalassa dhammakathaṃ sotuṃ gacchati. Tassa niccaṃ satthu santikaṃ
dhpak2.3:9.3: gacchantassa pabbajjāya cittaṃ nami. So ayyakaṃ āha – “sace maṃ
dhpak2.3:9.4: anujāneyyātha, ahaṃ pabbajeyya”nti. “Kiṃ vadesi, tāta, sakalassa
dhpak2.3:9.5: lokassapi me pabbajjāto tava pabbajjā bhaddikā. Sace sakkosi pabbajāhī”ti.
dhpak2.3:10.1: Taṃ satthu santikaṃ netvā, “kiṃ, gahapati, dārako te laddho”ti
dhpak2.3:10.2: vutte, “āma, bhante, ayaṃ me nattā tumhākaṃ santike pabbajitukāmo”ti
dhpak2.3:10.3: āha. Satthā aññataraṃ piṇḍapātacārikaṃ bhikkhuṃ “imaṃ dārakaṃ
dhpak2.3:10.4: pabbājehī”ti āṇāpesi. Thero tassa tacapañcakakammaṭṭhānaṃ ācikkhitvā
dhpak2.3:10.5: pabbājesi. So bahuṃ buddhavacanaṃ uggaṇhitvā paripuṇṇavasso upasampadaṃ
dhpak2.3:10.6: labhitvā yonisomanasikārena kammaṭṭhānaṃ karonto arahattaṃ pāpuṇi.
dhpak2.3:11.2: “sakkā nu kho idaṃ sukhaṃ cūḷapanthakassa dātu”nti! Tato
dhpak2.3:11.5: “Pabbājetha, bhante”ti. Seṭṭhi kira sāsane ca suppasanno,
dhpak2.3:11.7: vattuṃ lajjati, tasmā sukheneva tesaṃ pabbajjaṃ anujāni.
dhpak2.3:13.1: “Padmaṃ yathā kokanadaṃ sugandhaṃ, Pāto siyā phullamavītagandhaṃ; Aṅgīrasaṃ
dhpak2.3:13.2: passa virocamānaṃ, Tapantamādiccamivantalikkhe”ti. (saṃ. ni. 1.123; a. ni. 5.195) –
dhpak2.3:14.1: Imaṃ ekaṃ gāthaṃ catūhi māsehi uggaṇhituṃ nāsakkhi. So kira
dhpak2.3:14.2: kassapasammāsambuddhakāle pabbajitvā paññavā hutvā aññatarassa dandhabhikkhuno
dhpak2.3:14.3: uddesaggahaṇakāle parihāsakeḷiṃ akāsi. So bhikkhu tena parihāsena
dhpak2.3:14.4: lajjito neva uddesaṃ gaṇhi, na sajjhāyamakāsi. Tena kammena ayaṃ
dhpak2.3:14.5: pabbajitvāva dandho jāto, gahitagahitaṃ padaṃ uparūparipadaṃ gaṇhantassa
dhpak2.3:14.6: nassati. Tassa imameva gāthaṃ uggahetuṃ vāyamantassa cattāro māsā atikkantā.
dhpak2.3:15.2: sāsane abhabbo, catūhi māsehi ekaṃ gāthampi
dhpak2.3:15.3: gaṇhituṃ na sakkosi, pabbajitakiccaṃ pana kathaṃ matthakaṃ
dhpak2.3:15.5: Cūḷapanthako buddhasāsane sinehena gihibhāvaṃ na pattheti.
dhpak2.3:16.1: Tasmiñca kāle mahāpanthako bhattuddesako ahosi. Jīvako komārabhacco bahuṃ
dhpak2.3:16.2: mālāgandhavilepanaṃ ādāya attano ambavanaṃ gantvā satthāraṃ pūjetvā dhammaṃ sutvā uṭṭhāyāsanā
dhpak2.3:16.3: dasabalaṃ vanditvā mahāpanthakaṃ upasaṅkamitvā, “kittakā, bhante, satthu santike
dhpak2.3:16.4: bhikkhū”ti pucchi. “Pañcamattāni bhikkhusatānī”ti. “Sve, bhante, buddhappamukhāni pañca
dhpak2.3:16.5: bhikkhusatāni ādāya amhākaṃ nivesane bhikkhaṃ gaṇhathā”ti. “Upāsaka, cūḷapanthako nāma
dhpak2.3:16.6: bhikkhu dandho aviruḷhidhammo, taṃ ṭhapetvā sesānaṃ nimantanaṃ sampaṭicchāmī”ti thero āha.
dhpak2.3:17.1: Taṃ sutvā cūḷapanthako cintesi – “thero ettakānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ
dhpak2.3:17.2: nimantanaṃ sampaṭicchanto maṃ bāhiraṃ katvā sampaṭicchati,
dhpak2.3:17.3: nissaṃsayaṃ mayhaṃ bhātikassa mayi cittaṃ bhinnaṃ bhavissati,
dhpak2.3:17.4: kiṃ dāni mayhaṃ iminā sāsanena, gihī hutvā dānādīni puññāni
dhpak2.3:17.5: karonto jīvissāmī”ti? So punadivase pātova vibbhamituṃ pāyāsi.
dhpak2.3:18.1: Satthā paccūsakāleyeva lokaṃ volokento imaṃ kāraṇaṃ disvā paṭhamataraṃ gantvā
dhpak2.3:18.2: cūḷapanthakassa gamanamagge dvārakoṭṭhake caṅkamanto aṭṭhāsi. Cūḷapanthako gacchanto
dhpak2.3:18.3: satthāraṃ disvā upasaṅkamitvā vanditvā aṭṭhāsi. Atha naṃ satthā “kuhiṃ pana tvaṃ,
dhpak2.3:18.4: cūḷapanthaka, imāya velāya gacchasī”ti āha. “Bhātā maṃ, bhante, nikkaḍḍhati, tenāhaṃ
dhpak2.3:18.5: vibbhamituṃ gacchāmī”ti. “Cūḷapanthaka, tava pabbajjā nāma mama santakā, bhātarā
dhpak2.3:18.6: nikkaḍḍhito kasmā mama santikaṃ nāgañchi, ehi, kiṃ te gihibhāvena, mama santike bhavissasī”ti
dhpak2.3:19.1: cakkaṅkitatalena pāṇinā taṃ sirasi parāmasitvā ādāya gantvā
dhpak2.3:19.4: hohī”ti iddhiyā abhisaṅkhataṃ parisuddhaṃ pilotikaṃ datvā kāle ārocite
dhpak2.3:19.5: bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto jīvakassa gehaṃ gantvā paññattāsane nisīdi.
dhpak2.3:20.1: Cūḷapanthakopi sūriyaṃ olokento taṃ pilotikaṃ “rajoharaṇaṃ rajoharaṇa”nti parimajjanto
dhpak2.3:20.2: nisīdi. Tassa taṃ pilotikakhaṇḍaṃ parimajjantassa kiliṭṭhaṃ ahosi. Tato cintesi – “idaṃ
dhpak2.3:20.3: pilotikakhaṇḍaṃ ativiya parisuddhaṃ, imaṃ pana attabhāvaṃ nissāya purimapakatiṃ vijahitvā evaṃ
dhpak2.3:20.4: kiliṭṭhaṃ jātaṃ, aniccā vata saṅkhārā”ti khayavayaṃ paṭṭhapento vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhesi. Satthā
dhpak2.3:20.5: “cūḷapanthakassa cittaṃ vipassanaṃ āruḷha”nti ñatvā, “cūḷapanthaka, tvaṃ pilotikakhaṇḍameva
dhpak2.3:20.6: saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ ‘rajaṃ raja’nti mā saññaṃ kari, abbhantare pana te rāgarajādayo atthi, te
dhpak2.3:20.7: harāhī”ti vatvā obhāsaṃ vissajjetvā purato nisinno viya paññāyamānarūpo hutvā imā gāthā abhāsi –
dhpak2.3:21.1: “Rāgo rajo na ca pana reṇu vuccati, Rāgassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ rajoti;
dhpak2.3:21.2: Etaṃ rajjaṃ vippajahitva bhikkhavo, Viharanti te vigatarajassa sāsane.
dhpak2.3:22.1: “Doso rajo na ca pana reṇu vuccati, Dosassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ rajoti;
dhpak2.3:22.2: Etaṃ rajaṃ vippajahitva bhikkhavo, Viharanti te vigatarajassa sāsane.
dhpak2.3:23.1: “Moho rajo na ca pana reṇu vuccati, Mohassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ rajoti; Etaṃ rajaṃ
dhpak2.3:23.2: vippajahitva bhikkhavo, Viharanti te vigatarajassa sāsane”ti. (mahāni. 209);
dhpak2.3:24.2: pāpuṇi. Saha paṭisambhidāhiyevassa tīṇi piṭakāni āgamiṃsu.
dhpak2.3:25.1: So kira pubbe rājā hutvā nagaraṃ padakkhiṇaṃ karonto nalāṭato
dhpak2.3:25.2: sede muccante parisuddhena sāṭakena nalāṭantaṃ puñchi, sāṭako
dhpak2.3:25.3: kiliṭṭho ahosi. So “imaṃ sarīraṃ nissāya evarūpo parisuddho
dhpak2.3:25.4: sāṭako pakatiṃ jahitvā kiliṭṭho jāto, aniccā vata saṅkhārā”ti
dhpak2.3:25.5: aniccasaññaṃ paṭilabhi. Te kāraṇenassa rajoharaṇameva paccayo jāto.
dhpak2.3:26.1: Jīvakopi kho komārabhacco dasabalassa dakkhiṇodakaṃ upanāmesi. Satthā “nanu, jīvaka,
dhpak2.3:26.2: vihāre bhikkhū atthī”ti hatthena pattaṃ pidahi. Mahāpanthako “nanu, bhante, vihāre
dhpak2.3:26.3: bhikkhū natthī”ti āha. Satthā “atthi, jīvakā”ti āha. Jīvako “tena hi bhaṇe gaccha, vihāre
dhpak2.3:26.4: bhikkhūnaṃ atthibhāvaṃ vā natthibhāvaṃ vā tvaññeva jānāhī”ti purisaṃ pesesi. Tasmiṃ
dhpak2.3:26.5: khaṇe cūḷapanthako “mayhaṃ bhātiko ‘vihāre bhikkhū natthī’ti bhaṇati, vihāre bhikkhūnaṃ
dhpak2.3:26.6: atthibhāvamassa pakāsessāmī”ti sakalaṃ ambavanaṃ bhikkhūnaññeva pūresi. Ekacce bhikkhū
dhpak2.3:26.7: cīvarakammaṃ karonti, ekacce rajanakammaṃ karonti, ekacce sajjhāyaṃ karonti. Evaṃ
dhpak2.3:26.8: aññamaññaasadisaṃ bhikkhusahassaṃ māpesi. So puriso vihāre bahū bhikkhū disvā nivattitvā,
dhpak2.3:26.9: “ayya, sakalaṃ ambavanaṃ bhikkhūhi paripuṇṇa”nti jīvakassa ārocesi. Theropi kho tattheva –
dhpak2.3:28.1: Atha satthā taṃ purisaṃ āha – “vihāraṃ gantvā ‘satthā cūḷapanthakaṃ nāma pakkosatī’ti
dhpak2.3:28.2: vadehī”ti. Tena gantvā tathā vutte, “ahaṃ cūḷapanthako, ahaṃ cūḷapanthako”ti mukhasahassaṃ uṭṭhahi.
dhpak2.3:28.3: So puriso puna gantvā, “sabbepi kira, bhante, cūḷapanthakāyeva nāmā”ti āha. “Tena hi gantvā yo
dhpak2.3:28.4: ‘ahaṃ cūḷapanthako’ti paṭhamaṃ vadati, taṃ hatthe gaṇha, avasesā antaradhāyissantī”ti. So
dhpak2.3:28.5: tathā akāsi. Tāvadeva sahassamattā bhikkhū antaradhāyiṃsu. Theropi tena purisena saddhiṃ agamāsi.
dhpak2.3:29.2: cūḷapanthakassa pattaṃ gaṇhāhi, ayaṃ te anumodanaṃ karissatī”ti. Jīvako tathā akāsi.
dhpak2.3:29.3: Thero sīhanādaṃ nadanto taruṇasīho viya tīhi piṭakehi saṅkhobhetvā
dhpak2.3:29.4: anumodanamakāsi. Satthā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto vihāraṃ gantvā
dhpak2.3:29.5: bhikkhūhi vatte dassite gandhakuṭippamukhe ṭhatvā bhikkhusaṅghassa
dhpak2.3:29.6: sugatovādaṃ datvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ kathetvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ uyyojetvā
dhpak2.3:29.7: surabhigandhavāsitaṃ gandhakuṭiṃ pavisitvā dakkhiṇena passena sīhaseyyaṃ upagato.
dhpak2.3:30.1: Atha sāyanhasamaye bhikkhū ito cito ca samosaritvā rattakambalasāṇiyā
dhpak2.3:30.2: parikkhittā viya nisīditvā satthu guṇakathaṃ ārabhiṃsu, “āvuso, mahāpanthako
dhpak2.3:30.3: cūḷapanthakassa ajjhāsayaṃ ajānanto catūhi māsehi ekaṃ gāthaṃ uggaṇhāpetuṃ na sakkoti,
dhpak2.3:30.4: ‘dandho aya’nti vihārā nikkaḍḍhi, sammāsambuddho pana attano
dhpak2.3:30.5: anuttaradhammarājatāya ekasmiṃyevassa antarabhatte saha paṭisambhidāhi arahattaṃ adāsi, tīṇi
dhpak2.3:30.6: piṭakāni saha paṭisambhidāhiyeva āgatāni, aho buddhānaṃ balaṃ nāma mahanta”nti.
dhpak2.3:31.1: Atha bhagavā dhammasabhāyaṃ imaṃ kathāpavattiṃ ñatvā, “ajja
dhpak2.3:31.2: mayā gantuṃ vaṭṭatī”ti buddhaseyyāya uṭṭhāya surattadupaṭṭaṃ
dhpak2.3:31.3: nivāsetvā vijjulataṃ viya kāyabandhanaṃ bandhitvā rattakambalasadisaṃ
dhpak2.3:31.8: khobhayamāno yugandharamatthake bālasūriyo viya āsanamajjhe nisīdi.
dhpak2.3:32.1: Sammāsambuddhe pana āgatamatte bhikkhusaṅgho kathaṃ pacchinditvā tuṇhī
dhpak2.3:32.2: ahosi. Satthā mudukena mettacittena parisaṃ oloketvā, “ayaṃ parisā ativiya
dhpak2.3:32.3: sobhati, ekassapi hatthakukkuccaṃ vā pādakukkuccaṃ vā ukkāsitasaddo vā khipitasaddo
dhpak2.3:32.4: vā natthi, sabbepi ime buddhagāravena sagāravā, buddhatejena tajjitā. Mayi
dhpak2.3:32.5: āyukappampi akathetvā nisinne paṭhamaṃ kathaṃ samuṭṭhāpetvā na kathessanti.
dhpak2.3:32.6: Kathāsamuṭṭhāpanavattaṃ nāma mayāva jānitabbaṃ, ahameva paṭhamaṃ kathessāmī”ti
dhpak2.3:33.2: bhikkhave, etarahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarākathā
dhpak2.3:33.4: cūḷapanthako idāneva dandho, pubbepi dandhoyeva. Na kevalañcassāhaṃ idāneva
dhpak2.3:33.5: avassayo jāto, pubbepi avassayo ahosimeva. Pubbe panāhaṃ imaṃ
dhpak2.3:33.6: lokiyakuṭumbassa sāmikaṃ akāsiṃ, idāni lokuttarakuṭumbassā”ti vatvā
dhpak2.3:33.7: tamatthaṃ vitthārato sotukāmehi bhikkhūhi āyācito atītaṃ āhari –
dhpak2.3:34.1: “Atīte, bhikkhave, bārāṇasinagaravāsī eko māṇavo takkasilaṃ gantvā
dhpak2.3:34.3: pañcannaṃ māṇavakasatānaṃ antare ativiya ācariyassa upakārako ahosi,
dhpak2.3:34.4: pādaparikammādīni sabbakiccāni karoti. Dandhatāya pana kiñci
dhpak2.3:34.5: uggaṇhituṃ na sakko”ti. Ācariyo “ayaṃ mama bahūpakāro, sikkhāpessāmi na”nti
dhpak2.3:34.6: vāyamantopi kiñci sikkhāpetuṃ na sakkoti. So ciraṃ vasitvā
dhpak2.3:34.7: ekagāthampi uggaṇhituṃ asakkonto ukkaṇṭhitvā “gamissāmī”ti ācariyaṃ āpucchi.
dhpak2.3:35.1: Ācariyo cintesi – “ayaṃ mayhaṃ upakārako, paṇḍitabhāvamassa paccāsīsāmi, na
dhpak2.3:35.2: naṃ kātuṃ sakkomi, avassaṃ mayā imassa paccupakāro kātabbo, ekamassa mantaṃ
dhpak2.3:35.3: bandhitvā dassāmī”ti so taṃ araññaṃ netvā “ghaṭṭesi ghaṭṭesi, kiṃ kāraṇā
dhpak2.3:35.4: ghaṭṭesi? Ahampi taṃ jānāmi jānāmī”ti imaṃ mantaṃ bandhitvā uggaṇhāpento
dhpak2.3:35.5: anekasatakkhattuṃ parivattāpetvā, “paññāyati te”ti pucchitvā, “āma, paññāyatī”ti vutte
dhpak2.3:35.6: “dandhena nāma vāyāmaṃ katvā paguṇaṃ kataṃ sippaṃ na palāyatī”ti cintetvā
dhpak2.3:35.7: maggaparibbayaṃ datvā, “gaccha, imaṃ mantaṃ nissāya jīvissasi, apalāyanatthāya
dhpak2.3:35.8: panassa niccaṃ sajjhāyaṃ kareyyāsī”ti vatvā taṃ uyyojesi. Athassa mātā
dhpak2.3:35.9: bārāṇasiyaṃ sampattakāle “putto me sippaṃ sikkhitvā āgato”ti mahāsakkārasammānaṃ akāsi.
dhpak2.3:36.1: Tadā bārāṇasirājā “atthi nu kho me kāyakammādīsu koci doso”ti
dhpak2.3:36.2: paccavekkhanto attano aruccanakaṃ kiñci kammaṃ adisvā “attano vajjaṃ nāma
dhpak2.3:36.3: attano na paññāyati, paresaṃ paññāyati, nāgarānaṃ pariggaṇhissāmī”ti
dhpak2.3:36.5: nisinnamanussānaṃ kathāsallāpo nāma nānappakārako hoti, ‘sacāhaṃ adhammena rajjaṃ
dhpak2.3:36.6: kāremi, pāpena adhammikena raññā daṇḍabaliādīhi hatamhā’ti vakkhanti.
dhpak2.3:36.7: ‘Sace dhammena rajjaṃ kāremi, dīghāyuko hotu no rājā’tiādīni vatvā
dhpak2.3:36.8: mama guṇaṃ kathessantī”ti tesaṃ tesaṃ gehānaṃ bhittianusāreneva vicarati.
dhpak2.3:37.1: Tasmiṃ khaṇe umaṅgacorā dvinnaṃ gehānaṃ antare umaṅgaṃ bhindanti
dhpak2.3:37.2: ekaumaṅgeneva dve gehāni pavisanatthāya. Rājā te disvā gehacchāyāya aṭṭhāsi.
dhpak2.3:37.3: Tesaṃ umaṅgaṃ bhinditvā gehaṃ pavisitvā bhaṇḍakaṃ olokitakāle māṇavo
dhpak2.3:37.4: pabujjhitvā taṃ mantaṃ sajjhāyanto “ghaṭṭesi ghaṭṭesi, kiṃ kāraṇā ghaṭṭesi?
dhpak2.3:37.5: Ahampi taṃ jānāmi jānāmī”ti āha. Te taṃ sutvā, “iminā kiramhā ñātā, idāni
dhpak2.3:37.7: sammukhasammukhaṭṭhāneneva palāyiṃsu. Rājā te palāyante disvā itarassa ca
dhpak2.3:37.8: mantasajjhāyanasaddaṃ sutvā gehaññeva vavatthapetvā nāgarānaṃ pariggaṇhitvā nivesanaṃ pāvisi.
dhpak2.3:38.1: So vibhātāya pana rattiyā pātovekaṃ purisaṃ pakkositvā āha – “gaccha
dhpak2.3:38.2: bhaṇe, asukavīthiyaṃ nāma yasmiṃ gehe umaṅgo bhinno, tattha takkasilato
dhpak2.3:38.3: sippaṃ uggaṇhitvā āgatamāṇavo atthi, taṃ ānehī”ti. So gantvā “rājā
dhpak2.3:38.4: taṃ pakkosatī”ti vatvā māṇavaṃ ānesi. Atha naṃ rājā āha – “tvaṃ, tāta,
dhpak2.3:38.6: taṃ sippaṃ dehī”ti. “Sādhu, deva, samānāsane nisīditvā gaṇhāhī”ti.
dhpak2.3:38.7: Rājāpi tathā katvā mantaṃ gahetvā “ayaṃ te ācariyabhāgo”ti sahassaṃ adāsi.
dhpak2.3:39.1: Tadā senāpati rañño kappakaṃ āha – “kadā rañño massuṃ
dhpak2.3:39.2: karissasī”ti? “Sve vā parasuve vā”ti. So tassa sahassaṃ
dhpak2.3:39.3: datvā “kiccaṃ me atthī”ti vatvā, “kiṃ, sāmī”ti vutte “rañño
dhpak2.3:39.4: massukammaṃ karonto viya hutvā khuraṃ ativiya pahaṃsitvā
dhpak2.3:39.5: galanāḷiṃ chinda, tvaṃ senāpati bhavissasi, ahaṃ rājā”ti.
dhpak2.3:40.2: massuṃ temetvā khuraṃ pahaṃsitvā nalāṭante gahetvā, “khuro thokaṃ
dhpak2.3:40.3: kuṇṭhadhāro, ekappahāreneva galanāḷiṃ chindituṃ vaṭṭatī”ti puna
dhpak2.3:40.4: ekamantaṃ ṭhatvā khuraṃ pahaṃsi. Tasmiṃ khaṇe rājā attano mantaṃ saritvā
dhpak2.3:40.5: sajjhāyaṃ karonto “ghaṭṭesi ghaṭṭesi, kiṃ kāraṇā ghaṭṭesi? Ahampi taṃ
dhpak2.3:40.6: jānāmi jānāmī”ti āha. Nhāpitassa nalāṭato sedā mucciṃsu. So “jānāti mama
dhpak2.3:40.7: kāraṇaṃ rājā”ti bhīto khuraṃ bhūmiyaṃ khipitvā pādamūle urena nipajji.
dhpak2.3:41.1: Rājāno nāma chekā honti, tena taṃ evamāha – “are, duṭṭha,
dhpak2.3:41.2: nhāpita, ‘na maṃ rājā jānātī’ti saññaṃ karosī”ti. “Abhayaṃ
dhpak2.3:41.3: me dehi, devā”ti. “Hotu, mā bhāyi, kathehī”ti. Senāpati
dhpak2.3:41.4: me, deva, sahassaṃ datvā, “rañño massuṃ karonto viya
dhpak2.3:41.5: galanāḷiṃ chinda, ahaṃ rājā hutvā taṃ senāpatiṃ karissāmī”ti āhāti.
dhpak2.3:42.1: Rājā taṃ sutvā “ācariyaṃ me nissāya jīvitaṃ laddha”nti cintetvā senāpatiṃ
dhpak2.3:42.2: pakkosāpetvā, “ambho, senāpati, kiṃ nāma tayā mama santikā na laddhaṃ,
dhpak2.3:42.3: idāni taṃ daṭṭhuṃ na sakkomi, mama raṭṭhā nikkhamāhī”ti taṃ raṭṭhā pabbājetvā
dhpak2.3:43.1: ācariyaṃ pakkosāpetvā, “ācariya, taṃ nissāya mayā jīvitaṃ
dhpak2.3:43.2: laddha”nti vatvā mahantaṃ sakkāraṃ karitvā tassa senāpatiṭṭhānaṃ adāsi.
dhpak2.3:45.3: avassayo hutvā taṃ lokiyakuṭumbe patiṭṭhāpesi”nti vatvā
dhpak2.3:46.1: puna ekadivasaṃ “aho satthā cūḷapanthakassa avassayo jāto”ti
dhpak2.3:47.1: “Appakenāpi medhāvī, pābhatena vicakkhaṇo; Samuṭṭhāpeti attānaṃ, aṇuṃ aggiṃva sandhama”nti. (jā. 1.1.4) –
dhpak2.3:48.1: Gāthaṃ vatvā, “na, bhikkhave, idānevāhaṃ imassa avassayo jāto, pubbepi
dhpak2.3:48.2: avassayo ahosimeva. Pubbe panāhaṃ imaṃ lokiyakuṭumbassa sāmikaṃ akāsiṃ,
dhpak2.3:48.3: idāni lokuttarakuṭumbassa. Tadā hi cūḷantevāsiko cūḷapanthako ahosi,
dhpak2.3:48.4: cūḷaseṭṭhi pana paṇḍito byatto nakkhattakovido ahamevā”ti jātakaṃ samodhānesi.
dhpak2.3:49.2: catūhi māsehi catuppadaṃ gāthaṃ gahetuṃ asakkontopi vīriyaṃ
dhpak2.3:49.3: anossajjitvāva arahatte patiṭṭhito, idāni lokuttaradhammakuṭumbassa sāmiko jāto”ti.
dhpak2.3:50.1: Satthā āgantvā, “kāya nuttha, bhikkhave, etarahi kathāya sannisinnā”ti
dhpak2.3:50.3: āraddhavīriyo bhikkhu lokuttaradhammassa sāmiko hotiyevā”ti vatvā imaṃ gāthamāha –
dhpak2.3:51.2: Dīpaṃ kayirātha medhāvī, yaṃ ogho nābhikīratī”ti.
dhpak2.3:52.1: Tattha dīpaṃ kayirāthāti vīriyasaṅkhātena uṭṭhānena, satiyā avippavāsākārasaṅkhātena appamādena,
dhpak2.3:52.2: catupārisuddhisīlasaṅkhātena saṃyamena, indriyadamena cāti imehi kāraṇabhūtehi catūhi dhammehi dhammojapaññāya
dhpak2.3:52.3: samannāgato medhāvī imasmiṃ ativiya dullabhapatiṭṭhatāya atigambhīre saṃsārasāgare attano
dhpak2.3:52.4: patiṭṭhānabhūtaṃ arahattaphalaṃ dīpaṃ kayirātha kareyya, kātuṃ sakkuṇeyyāti attho. Kīdisaṃ? Yaṃ ogho nābhikīratīti yaṃ
dhpak2.3:52.5: catubbidhopi kilesogho abhikirituṃ viddhaṃsetuṃ na sakkoti. Na hi sakkā arahattaṃ oghena abhikiritunti.
